headline: Google has updated its AI shopping tools for the holidays, adding a Merchant Center tab that shows retailers what shoppers ask its AI, and shopping features on YouTube.
score_reason: Retail Brew describes a progress update on tools announced earlier (Rethink event in September), with analysts calling adoption "fairly limited"; score lowered by 1.
importance_line: Retailers can see real shopper wording on Google's AI surfaces and buy through AI search, but analysts say shoppers have been slow to adopt it.
summary: Retail Brew reports that Google added an AI performance insights tab in Merchant Center, which lets retailers see what shoppers type on AI surfaces such as AI Mode, and started beta testing business chat agents for YouTube ads. Tapestry now uses Google's UCP-powered checkout for Coach and Kate Spade purchases in AI search, but analyst Sky Canaves says adoption is "fairly limited" and the event was mostly a progress update rather than new announcements.
notes: Announcements were made at Google's Rethink event in September (day not stated) and many features were first announced in January; score lowered by 1 (5 to 4). Freshness date not parseable because no day is given.
